As a professional with years of experience in the roofing industry, I cannot stress enough the importance of regular roof inspections. Many homeowners overlook this crucial maintenance task until it's too late, leading to costly repairs or even complete roof replacements. I always advise my clients to be proactive and schedule routine inspections to catch any signs of damage early on. When was the last time you inspected your roof for damage? It's a question that often draws blank stares from homeowners who are unaware of the potential risks of neglecting their roof. From missing shingles to water leaks, there are a multitude of issues that can arise without proper maintenance. As a professional, I recommend conducting a thorough inspection at least once a year, especially after severe weather events like storms or hail. reviews.text:
A short while back I replaced the  roof on my house. I interviewed three companies, Saul Martinez of Roofboys Roofing, being one of them. Saul came across as friendly, Knowledgeable and customer friendly individual. He inspected my roof and
informed me of things I was already aware of. He made suggestions on correcting our shortcomings.
Replacing the roof was our goal. He went into detail on what he would do and alerted us on things he might find once the old roof was removed. There were some roof panels needed replacing. We had already discussed the possibility of having unseen roof damage. I was impressed with Saul's professionalism. He held true to the things we discussed prior to installation and most important, he stuck to the price he quoted us with adjustments on things found after roof removal.
Shop around folks and be sure you include Roofboys Roofing in your search. One company quoted an outragious price. Saul's quote was fair and within my expectations.
We are pleased with the work Saul's company did. He had a great crew working for us. Installation and clean up was great. Impressed with the short time it took to complete the job. Highly skilled and knowledgeable employees. Highly recommend Roofboys Roofing for your roofing needs. Very deservant of a 5 star rateing.
Thanks Saul.
reviews.author: Santiago Ponce

reviews.text: Roofboys did an amazing job on our fence! They came out quickly and gave us an estimate. They started work immediately. Awesome communication. They helped us stay in budget. Saul & Daisy live here in our neighborhood. We knew these were good honest people we could trust. I would recommend them to everyone and we will definitely use them for roofs, fences and everything in the future.
reviews.author: Allison Williams

reviews.text: Saul and his team are top notch. His knowledge about the roofing industry and recommendations for my project were greatly appreciated. Saul and Devon provided quick answers to any questions or concerns brought to him. The work done is high quality and demonstrates an attention detail that is worth mentioning. I definitely recommend Roofboys to anyone needing roof replacements or repairs for a fair price, excellent customer service and workmanship. 5 Stars!
reviews.author: Ken Brown

reviews.text: Many Many thanks to Cesar Mendoza and Roofboys Roofing & Construction LLC for coming out and tarping my roof to save my ceiling from further damage.  I called and they had someone on my roof in less than an hour!  Need help with your roof, don’t hesitate to give them a call and they will take care of you, and fast!!
reviews.author: elizabeth mendoza

reviews.text: Saul came to our rescue after the storm on Tuesday morning. The tree had split and fallen on the house. He brought over the crew and they had the tree removed within hours, the roof tarped and leak sealed. We can't imagine getting through this without him and his team.
reviews.author: Liz Thurman

reviews.text: After the storm on 5/28, Saul came by inspected our roof. He did a through job explaining all issues & included pictures. He recommended a very economical Roof Tuneup since there were only minor issues. It's refreshing to know that Saul & Roofboys are open & honest. He did not try to sell me a new roof like so many other companies. He & his staff are trustworthy, courteous & professional. I have already recommend Roofboys to a friend & will continue to do so. Thank to Saul & your whole team for a great experience.
reviews.author: Wayne & Christina Berkel

reviews.text: I highly recommend Roofboys Roofing & Construction!! They’re honest, reliable, and affordable. Great people!!
reviews.author: Richelle Garcia

reviews.text: Communication was great from beginning to end. I would highly recommend them for all roofing needs.
reviews.author: Tiara Hill
